scope: 原1178父规则与1196填带参考的受驱Hartree线性化，保全部源CAR跃迁、两关系及交叉反馈后，相同格距/耦合的各轴至少3点周期盒中，全q及实频|omega|<=1/4的加权反馈范数<.835、逆余量>.165。停止把该参考的同一受驱核直接作为低频无质量几何部门；不签有限K全谱、任意初态、实际仪器或全部有限有效GR排除。

numerical_algebra_audit.scope: Numerical algebra audit only, not a finite-K physical gap or detector certificate.

inputs_retained: Original 1178 parent couplings, finite lattice spacing, all CAR source modes and reciprocal relation interaction.
1196 stationary isotropic filled Hartree reference with z_s >= .98; not a finite-K ground state.
Retarded linear response with fixed initial occupations; real frequency window [-1/4,1/4].
Original lapse and three-axis transport dictionary; no new instrument or freely implemented driving control.
certification_limits: Weighted response inverse, not Euclidean singular-value bound without conditioning factors.
No full finite-K gap, general initial-state spectrum, complex-frequency stability, or unknown-probe/reference finite-time certificate.
Other references, relation rules, initial occupation sources and controlled finite-window GR approximations remain open.
No identification or exclusion of dark matter/dark energy; no general cognitive-axiom nonentailment or nonlinear Einstein generation.
review_independence: An independent agent derived the Fourier vertices, spectral Gram bounds, reciprocal tangent and feedback sign, and independently recomputed rational constants without importing author code. A second agent independently checked the uniform-box fixed-point lower bound by exact fractions and reported it in messages; root archived those messages after the agent file-writing attempt hit capacity. Root checked the formal proof and executed two independent position/momentum numerical constructions. A further agent pass over the final numerical program encountered service capacity error; that program was not independently reimplemented. Internal non-blind review.
